user.title: Connect to Petivity
user.description: Petivity only allows sign-in through its own login page, so this integration reuses the session that page creates. Sign in at {login_url} in a desktop browser, open the developer tools, and under Application (Chrome, Edge) or Storage (Firefox) > Cookies > {login_url} copy the values of the `id_token` and `refresh_token` cookies. The README has step-by-step instructions.

reauth_confirm.title: Petivity sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Petivity no longer accepts the stored session. Sign in at {login_url} again and paste the new `id_token` and `refresh_token` cookie values.

error.invalid_auth: Petivity rejected this session. Copy both cookies again right after signing in.

abort.already_configured: This Petivity household is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Those cookies belong to a different Petivity household.
